source_limits: Getzler’s BV algebra includes a separate cochain differential Q; no Q-compatibility claim is imported.
Seidel uses a degree -1 BV operator and flags errors in later lectures; only Lecture 12 §12.7 is used, and signs are rederived in the local degree +1 proof.

Kosmann–Schwarzbach and Monterde formulate the general odd bracket in Z/2 degree and use different degrees in geometric examples; the QME normalization conversion is shown explicitly in the local definition.
Schwarz’s odd-symplectic integration theorem requires geometric Lagrangian and volume data; no measure, path-integral, convergence, or anomaly conclusion is asserted.
Weibel Exercise 7.7.1 assigns d²=0 to the reader; that exercise is not proof evidence. The current published Chevalley–Eilenberg theorem supplies the complete proof.
No full BFV/Koszul–Tate resolution, field-dependent structure functions, reducibility, open gauge algebra, or quantum BRST cohomology is asserted.
